# Laramine — Copilot instructions

MIT Laravel project-management core, clean-room relative to Redmine. Full pointers: `AGENTS.md`. Contribution and CI rules: `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Quality bar: `QUALITY.md`. Vulnerability reports: `SECURITY.md`.

## Hard rules

- MySQL 8 is the app and test database. PHPUnit is forced there by `phpunit.xml`. SQLite is a documented local migrate smoke only.
- Before a PR: `composer lint` (Pint `--test`), `composer stan` (Larastan level 8, no baseline), `composer test` (PHPUnit Unit, Feature, and Parity). CI in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` must stay green. Do not weaken it.
- Clean-room: reimplement from Redmine 7.0.1 behavior and schema semantics. Never add GPLv2 Ruby, ERB, JS, or upstream tests to the tree. Structure dump for reference only: `docs/sources/redmine-7.0.1-schema.rb`.
- The P0 table and column layout row is **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/SchemaLayoutParityTest.php`. The users and authentication row is **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/UsersAuthParityTest.php`. The identity, projects nested-set, workflows, custom fields, queries, journals, time entries and attachments, outbound mail, activity, news, documents, and files, wiki, boards and forums, and calendar and Gantt rows are **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/IdentityAclParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/ProjectNestedSetParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/WorkflowParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/CustomFieldParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/IssueQueryParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/QueryRemainderParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/JournalParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/TimeEntryParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/AttachmentParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/NotificationParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/ActivityParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/ModulesNewsDocumentsFilesParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/WikiParityTest.php`, `tests/Parity/BoardsParityTest.php`, and `tests/Parity/CalendarGanttQueryParityTest.php` (`docs/parity-checklist.md`). Textile and Markdown rendering is **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/MarkupParityTest.php`. Wiki HTTP is **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/WikiHttpParityTest.php`. Boards and forums HTTP is **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/BoardsHttpParityTest.php`. Activity for changesets stays **NOT VERIFIED**. Wiki and boards visual UX stays **NOT VERIFIED**. Every other row is **NOT VERIFIED**. Do not mark another row VERIFIED without a fixture-backed comparison in `tests/Parity` and an evidence path. Do not call the project production-ready.
- The HTTP surface is the Inertia health smoke page at `GET /`, the Inertia sign-in page at `GET /login` (Blade form at `?view=blade`; `docs/frontend.md`, `docs/ux-parity-notes.md`: not UI-ready, not Redmine UX parity, not a 0.1 release), account and auth-probe routes, activity and issue Atom feeds, custom-field attachment reads, container attachment upload, claim, download, and thumbnail, minimal news, document, and file pages, minimal calendar, gantt, and project-list pages, and functional wiki and board pages. The download-all zip also accepts `wiki_pages` and `messages`. SCM and webhooks stay out. News, documents, files, wiki, forums, calendar, and gantt are compared on their checklist rows. Textile and Markdown rendering is **VERIFIED** by `tests/Parity/MarkupParityTest.php`. Issue journals are written on update and relation add. Quote, edit, and delete of a note also write; see `docs/domain.md` and `docs/journals-parity-gate.md`. Projects, membership, workflow, and issues have an MVP smoke in `docs/acl-workflow-parity-gate.md`. A **PASS** row in that gate's core checklist acceptance section is Laramine smoke, not the checklist **VERIFIED** mark. The identity, nested-set, and workflows rows are **VERIFIED** only by the parity tests named in the checklist. Neither gate is a 0.1 tag. Say so if you touch those edges.

## Where code lives

- Domain services: `app/Domain` (`Issues`, `Queries`, `CustomFields`, `Acl`, `Workflow`, `Projects`, `Notifications`, `Activity`).
- Eloquent models map Redmine 7.0.1 table and column names (`created_on` / `updated_on` where the schema uses them). STI `type` values stay Redmine class names (`IssueCustomField`, `WorkflowTransition`).
- Permission names are the strings in `App\Domain\Acl\PermissionCatalog`.
- Text columns that Redmine stores as YAML are JSON on write. YAML is read compatibility only, where the domain docs already say so.
- Tests: `tests/Unit`, `tests/Feature` (often `RefreshDatabase` and `Tests\Support\DomainFixture`), `tests/Parity`.
- Docs: `docs/domain.md`, `docs/custom-fields.md`, `docs/queries.md`, `docs/journals-parity-gate.md`, `docs/acl-workflow-parity-gate.md`, `docs/users-auth-spec.md`. Update the matching doc when behavior changes. Users/auth is locked there. Phase 2 is registration, `must_change_passwd`, and `recovery` / `register` tokens. Phases 3–10 are LDAP through the in-memory directory, TOTP, OAuth authorization code, API and feed tokens, the user directory, account administration, preferences, and session / autologin tokens. Do not add a second auth stack, a bcrypt password column, Sanctum, Fortify, Jetstream, Passport, a live LDAP client, or OpenID Connect from a side task. The compared rows are not a 0.1 tag.

## Domain work

For issues, queries, or custom fields, follow `.cursor/skills/continue-domain-work/SKILL.md`. Prefer extending the existing service and the documented operator or format catalog. Unknown filters and deferred formats fail closed; they do not match every row.

Imports stay at the top of the PHP file. Code comments are English. `match` on a backed enum stays exhaustive.
